tests.name: iter_access_array
tests.intent: Probes iterator dereference, increment, decrement and equality on array values using the optimized paths.

tests.name: iter_access_object
tests.intent: Probes iterator dereference, operator->, increment and equality on object values using the optimized paths.

tests.name: iter_access_primitive
tests.intent: Probes iterator operations on a primitive JSON wrapper using non-container fallback paths.

tests.name: destroy_deep_array
tests.intent: Probes bounded destruction and walk fallback behavior on deeply nested array structures.

tests.name: destroy_deep_object
tests.intent: Probes bounded destruction and walk fallback behavior on deeply nested object structures.

tests.name: destroy_all_children_leaves_array
tests.intent: Probes fast path container destruction when all children are leaf values in an array.

tests.name: destroy_all_children_leaves_object
tests.intent: Probes fast path container destruction when all children are leaf values in an object.

tests.name: diff_reordered_keys_ordered_json
tests.intent: Probes diff optimization and lazy add/remove building with reordered keys using ordered_json.

tests.name: diff_skipped_target_pass
tests.intent: Probes diff optimization where no keys are added and the target pass is skipped.

tests.name: diff_empty_source
tests.intent: Probes diff behavior when source is empty and target contains multiple members.

tests.name: diff_nested_equality_check
tests.intent: Probes diff child comparison using operator== before path construction in nested objects.

tests.name: iter_access_exceptions
tests.intent: Probes exception throwing behavior when dereferencing invalid iterator slots.

tests.name: iter_cross_container_compare
tests.intent: Probes iterator equality comparisons across different json instances or invalid states.

tests.name: diff_special_characters_keys
tests.intent: Probes diff generation with object keys containing JSON pointer escape characters like ~ and /.

tests.name: diff_iterative_deep_path
tests.intent: Probes the iterative deep diff path with complex nested container structures.

tests.name: destroy_mixed_container
tests.intent: Probes container destruction with a mix of nested containers and leaf values.

tests.name: iter_prefix_postfix_consistency
tests.intent: Probes prefix and postfix increment/decrement consistency on object iterators.

tests.name: diff_patch_roundtrip
tests.intent: Probes diff output correctness by successfully applying patch back to source to match target.

tests.name: destroy_empty_containers
tests.intent: Probes destruction paths for empty arrays and empty objects.

tests.name: iter_array_arrow_operator
tests.intent: Probes arrow operator -> on array iterators using fast paths.

tests.name: test_object_reverse_decrement
tests.intent: Exercises object iterator prefix and postfix decrement operator targeting the fast path for object type.

tests.name: test_destroy_bounded_object
tests.intent: Exercises destroy_bounded and object branch destruction for nested object trees exceeding the recursion threshold or structured correctly.

tests.name: test_diff_object_keys_reordered
tests.intent: Exercises diff_object_keys fast path, target_values vector, added vector, and subsequent diff additions when keys are reordered and new keys are added.

tests.name: test_diff_unequal_array
tests.intent: Exercises diff_unequal and array child comparison before path construction when elements inside arrays differ.

tests.name: test_iterative_diff_objects_complex
tests.intent: Exercises diff_iteratively with complex nested objects utilizing target_values and added vector moves on the iterative stack frame.

tests.name: diff_patch_roundtrip_fixed
tests.intent: Probes diff output correctness by successfully applying patch back to source to match target.

tests.name: diff_patch_roundtrip_fixed_fixed
tests.intent: Probes diff output correctness by successfully applying patch back to source to match target.
